name: Login - happy path
response: Navigate to login page. Enter valid username and valid password. Click login button. Assert success message is visible.
reference: Visit login page, enter valid credentials, submit the form, verify success message appears.

name: Login - wrong password
response: Navigate to login page. Enter valid username and incorrect password. Click login. Assert error message is visible.
reference: Visit login page, enter valid username and invalid password, submit form, verify error message is shown.

name: Login - empty username
response: Navigate to login page. Leave username blank. Enter any password. Click login. Assert validation error is shown.
reference: Visit login page, submit form with empty username field, verify a validation error message appears.

name: Login - empty password
response: Navigate to login page. Enter any username. Leave password blank. Click login. Assert error message is shown.
reference: Visit login page, submit form with empty password field, verify an error message is displayed.

name: Login - empty both fields
response: Navigate to login page. Leave both fields blank. Click login. Assert error message is shown.
reference: Visit login page, submit form without entering any credentials, verify an error message appears.

name: Dropdown - select first option
response: Navigate to dropdown page. Select the first available option from the dropdown. Assert the selected option is displayed.
reference: Visit dropdown page, select the first option from the dropdown, verify it is displayed as selected.

name: Dropdown - select second option
response: Navigate to dropdown page. Select the second available option from the dropdown. Assert the selected option is displayed.
reference: Visit dropdown page, select the second option from the dropdown, verify it is displayed as selected.

name: Dropdown - default state
response: Navigate to dropdown page. Assert no option is selected by default.
reference: Visit dropdown page, verify the dropdown shows a default placeholder and no option is pre-selected.

name: Checkbox - check unchecked box
response: Navigate to checkboxes page. Click an unchecked checkbox. Assert it is now checked.
reference: Visit checkboxes page, click an unchecked checkbox, verify it becomes checked.

name: Checkbox - uncheck checked box
response: Navigate to checkboxes page. Click a checkbox that is already checked. Assert it is now unchecked.
reference: Visit checkboxes page, click a checked checkbox, verify it becomes unchecked.

name: Checkbox - verify all checked
response: Navigate to checkboxes page. Check all available checkboxes. Assert all are in checked state.
reference: Visit checkboxes page, check all checkboxes, verify all are in checked state.

name: Form - fill all fields
response: Navigate to form page. Fill in all required fields with valid data. Click submit. Assert success message is shown.
reference: Visit form page, fill in all required fields with valid data, submit the form, verify a success confirmation appears.

name: Form - missing required field
response: Navigate to form page. Leave one required field empty. Click submit. Assert validation error is shown for that field.
reference: Visit form page, leave a required field empty, submit the form, verify a validation error appears for that field.

name: Drag and drop - move element
response: Navigate to drag and drop page. Drag the first element onto the second element. Assert the positions have swapped.
reference: Visit drag and drop page, drag the first element onto the second, verify the elements have swapped positions.

name: Hover - reveal hidden content
response: Navigate to hover page. Hover over an element. Assert hidden content becomes visible.
reference: Visit hover page, hover over an element, verify hidden content or tooltip appears.

name: Alert - accept alert
response: Navigate to alerts page. Trigger an alert. Accept it. Assert the result confirms acceptance.
reference: Visit alerts page, trigger a JavaScript alert, accept it, verify the result message confirms acceptance.

name: Alert - dismiss confirm dialog
response: Navigate to alerts page. Trigger a confirm dialog. Dismiss it. Assert the result confirms dismissal.
reference: Visit alerts page, trigger a JavaScript confirm dialog, dismiss it, verify the result message confirms dismissal.

name: File upload - upload a file
response: Navigate to file upload page. Select a file using the file input. Click upload. Assert the filename appears on the page.
reference: Visit file upload page, select a file, submit the upload, verify the uploaded filename appears on the page.

name: Dynamic content - content changes on reload
response: Navigate to dynamic content page. Capture the current content. Reload the page. Assert the content has changed.
reference: Visit dynamic content page, capture the current content, reload the page, verify the content has changed.

name: Infinite scroll - load more content
response: Navigate to infinite scroll page. Scroll to the bottom. Assert new content loads dynamically.
reference: Visit infinite scroll page, scroll to the bottom, verify additional content is dynamically loaded and appears on screen.
